page: Microsoft Azure DC2es_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV5 server family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel processor. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server type does not include any local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage options, though it is premium storage capable. There are no integrated GPUs, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Positioned within a memory-optimized family, the DC2es_v5 offers an entry-level resource profile for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation with a moderate memory footprint. Given the lack of local storage and GPU accelerators, this instance is suited for lightweight database nodes, small-scale enterprise applications, or development environments that utilize network-attached storage.
